title: Securities Dealing Policy
date_next_review: Reviewed every two years unless a material change is required earlier (next due 29 November 2024)

tiers.name: Employees
tiers.description: All Directors, officers, employees, contractors and secondees of South32 Limited and its related bodies corporate. This tier is bound only by the Insider Trading prohibitions in section 3; the closed periods (section 4), the pre-approval requirements (sections 5 and 6) and the restricted dealings list (section 6.9) do not reach an Employee who is not KMP, a South32 Lead Team member or a notified Restricted Employee.

tiers.name: Restricted Employees
tiers.description: Employees notified by Company Secretariat that additional restrictions apply, such as not dealing whilst their name is on a specific distribution list, a confidential project list or an insider list. Subject to closed periods and to prior approval for any dealing outside closed periods, but not to the section 6.9 restricted dealings list.

tiers.name: KMP
tiers.description: Persons discharging managerial responsibilities: Directors, and members of the South32 Lead Team listed in the remuneration report as KMP. Subject to closed periods, prior approval, same-day notification of all dealings and the section 6.9 ban on derivatives, short-term dealing, short selling, margin lending and other secured financing, and hedging.

tiers.name: South32 Lead Team members
tiers.description: Members of the South32 Lead Team who are not KMP. Same substantive restrictions as KMP (closed periods, prior approval from the CEO or delegate, and the section 6.9 restricted dealings), but the section 6.7/6.8 notification and regulatory disclosure obligations are expressed to apply only to KMP and their PCAs.

tiers.name: PCAs
tiers.description: Persons closely associated with KMP and South32 Lead Team members: spouse or civil partner; child under 18 who is unmarried and has no civil partner; a relative sharing the same household for at least one year at the date of dealing; any other family member who may be expected to influence or be influenced by the KMP or Lead Team member; and any company, legal person, trust, partnership or entity whose managerial responsibilities are discharged by, which is directly or indirectly controlled by, which is set up for the benefit of, or whose economic interests are substantially equivalent to those of such a person. Restrictions on dealings included or excluded under the Policy apply to PCAs, and KMP must file a list of their PCAs with the Company.

ad_hoc_blackout_authority: Section 4.3(c) allows 'any other period that is specified as a closed period for dealings from time to time', including a period specified if required by applicable law; the Policy does not name who specifies it. Separately, Company Secretariat may notify an Employee that they are a Restricted Employee and must not deal whilst their name is on a specific distribution list, a confidential project list or an insider list. The Policy does not say whether such designations are announced or kept confidential.

rules.detail: Absolute ban on trading in derivative products issued over or in respect of the Company's securities, with no venue limitation, no security-state carve-out and no approval route. Both legs of a collar (the purchased put and the written call) are derivative products in respect of South32 securities.

exemption_authority: Two routes. Section 8.2: the relevant approver (Chair of the Board, Chair of the Risk and Audit Committee, CEO or delegate, or Company Secretary depending on tier) may determine that the Policy does not apply to other types of dealings, provided no law or regulation is breached. Section 7.2: in exceptional circumstances the same approvers may permit a sale, but not a purchase, during a closed period, on evidence that sale is the only reasonable course of action and that approval is permitted under Australian and UK law. Neither route is expressed as available to waive the section 6.9 restricted dealings, although the section 8.2 wording is open-ended.
jurisdiction_overlays: UK: LSE listing; KMP and their PCAs must notify the UK Financial Conduct Authority of dealings within three business days, and closed-period relief must be permitted under UK as well as Australian law
South Africa: JSE listing; Company Secretariat discloses KMP dealings to the Johannesburg Stock Exchange
Australia: ASX Listing Rules and Guidance Note 27; ASX lodgement of Director dealings within five business days

bespoke_clauses.topic: restricted dealings bind only KMP and Lead Team
bespoke_clauses.clause: KMP and South32 Lead Team members must not undertake any of the following dealings ... (a) trade in derivative products ... (d) enter into margin lending or other secured financing arrangements ... (e) enter into any hedging arrangements that limit his or her exposure to the Company's securities.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The derivatives, hedging and secured financing bans are confined to KMP, South32 Lead Team members and their PCAs; a senior executive below the Lead Team faces only Insider Trading rules (and pre-approval plus closed periods if designated a Restricted Employee), so a funded collar is arguable for that population but not for the target directors and executives.

bespoke_clauses.topic: hedging ban is not limited to unvested shares
bespoke_clauses.clause: enter into any hedging arrangements that limit his or her exposure to the Company's securities
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Unlike policies that only ban hedging of unvested incentive securities, this prohibition covers a KMP's entire holding, so vesting the shares first does not open a route to a collar.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Dealing includes a wide range of transactions such as using the Company's shares as security for a loan and entering into any derivative contract which relates to the Company's securities.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Both the loan leg and the option legs of a funded collar are dealings, so each requires prior approval, falls inside the closed periods, and triggers same-day notification to Company Secretariat and disclosure to ASX, LSE, JSE and the FCA.

bespoke_clauses.clause: If, however, a member of the KMP South32 Lead Team or a Restricted Employee needs to deal (to sell but not buy) in securities during a closed period due to exceptional circumstances
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Even in hardship there is no route to enter, roll or unwind a collar during a closed period, because buying (including buying a put or closing out a written call) is excluded; only an outright sale can be approved.

bespoke_clauses.clause: the relevant approver may determine that this Policy does not apply to other types of dealings in respect of the Company's securities (for example: those listed in section 6.1 of ASX Listing Rules Guidance Note 27), provided that no such determination would breach any relevant law or regulation.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: This is the only conceivable route to a bank collar for a KMP, but it sits in the 'dealings excluded from this Policy' section rather than in section 6.9 and is illustrated only by routine GN27 exclusions, so it should not be relied on without a board-level waiver.

bespoke_clauses.clause: The approved dealing must occur within two business days following approval (or such other time specified in the approval), otherwise the approval is no longer effective and approval must be sought again.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Any approved transaction must be priced and executed within two business days, which is tight for negotiating and documenting an OTC collar and loan, although the approver can specify a longer window.

bespoke_clauses.clause: company, a legal person, trust partnership or other entity, the managerial responsibilities of which are discharged by the KMP ... which is directly or indirectly controlled by such a person or is set up for the benefit of such a person, or the economic interests of which are substantially equivalent to those of such a person.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Structuring the collar or the borrowing through an SPV, family trust or spouse does not escape the prohibitions, and KMP must file a list of these persons with the Company.

bespoke_clauses.clause: any other period that is specified as a closed period for dealings from time to time. In particular, this could include a period specified as a closed period if required to do so by applicable law.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Additional closed periods can be declared without notice and the Policy does not say they will be announced, so execution risk sits with the executive on any dated collar entry or unwind.

bespoke_clauses.clause: where securities in the Company granted under an employee, executive or director equity plan cease to be held under the terms of that plan, any dealings in those securities must only occur in accordance with this Policy.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Vested shares released from the incentive plan fall squarely back under the Policy, including the section 6.9 hedging and secured financing bans, so there is no post-vesting freedom to collar them.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Breaches of this Policy may also lead to disciplinary action being taken against the Employee, including forfeiture of securities and/or suspension or termination of employment.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Forfeiture of securities is an express sanction, which for a bank would put the collateral itself at risk if the structure were found to breach the Policy.

summary: A funded collar is not possible for a South32 director, KMP or Lead Team member. Section 6.9 imposes a flat, approval-free ban on four things a funded collar requires: trading derivative products issued over or in respect of South32 securities, entering hedging arrangements that limit exposure to those securities, entering margin lending or other secured financing arrangements in respect of them, and dealing on a short-term (three month) basis; the bans are not confined to unvested or plan securities and extend to spouses, controlled companies and trusts through the PCA definition. The only relief mechanisms are sale-only approvals in exceptional circumstances during a closed period and the open-ended section 8.2 power for the relevant approver to determine that the Policy does not apply to other types of dealings, which is illustrated only by routine Guidance Note 27 exclusions and should not be relied on without a board-level waiver. Below Lead Team level the position differs sharply: section 6.9 does not apply to ordinary Employees or notified Restricted Employees, for whom the option and loan legs are simply dealings requiring, at most, prior approval from the CEO or Company Secretary outside a closed period. Any transaction that were approved must be executed within two business days and, for KMP and their PCAs, notified to Company Secretariat by close of business on the day of dealing and on to ASX, LSE, JSE and the UK FCA.
